name: Школа 102 РП [Beta]
desc:
🎓 Welcome to School №102! 💫
💼 Here you can progress from Student to Director or choose another role: Teacher, Director, Security Guard, Bully, Doctor, and others! 

🎭 Systems that are only available to us: 
- Live lessons (Tasks, Tests, Grades, Meetings, Rhythm game with music and drawing in art class!)
- Rank system (The more you play, the higher the rank and the more abilities you get!)
- Work and business (Cooking, delivery, and your own retail outlets!)

🔧 Updates come almost every week! 🚀
